label: On RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 correlativity is concurrent actualization, checked (inference)
rule: Unfold standingReceipt: receipt is reception plus presence, so the present-tense reading is immediate and correlativity becomes 40a97664 with its arguments reordered
meaning: Closed result with no premises, quantified over every history, giving relation and reception predicate. On the standing-composition sense the present-tense reading of reception holds by definition, and correlativity (whatever is receiving at t is given being at t) says that whatever has received esse and is present at t is given being at t: weak concurrent actualization 40a97664, in both directions. It shows that on this sense correlativity is 40a97664 under another name. It establishes nothing about reality.
